description: Deformable registration using cubic B-spline free-form deformations
notes: Deformable non-rigid registration with B-spline control points. Most flexible, requires more computation. Uses LBFGS-B optimizer. overlap_padding=3 means 3 B-spline control points will extend beyond the image domain on each side (handling ITK's internal padding separately). metric_padding=20 voxels for metric overlap. Snapshots: 2×2 PNG layout with fixed | registered | checkerboard | registered+B-spline-mesh overlay. Full control-point mesh shown with dim yellow border marking original image extent.
